summary: No repository holds calibrated measurements of Spirogyra free-end-cell caps. BioImage Archive and IDR have no Spirogyra at all; AlgaeBase is a taxonomic site with illustrative images; the Cell Image Library has a single CC BY-NC-ND competition micrograph (CIL:41009) without visible scale metadata; GBIF has 8,551 Spirogyra occurrence photographs, uncalibrated. Cap height/radius ratios (dimensionless) could in principle be measured from images lacking absolute scale, but no image set is selected for free end cells.
next_step: Compile a small image set of Spirogyra filament ends (e.g., from GBIF/iNaturalist CC-licensed photos or a new culture) with cells imaged in profile, then pre-register measurement of cap height / R and fitted cap-sphere radius / R.
obstacles_confirmed: Open Spirogyra samples with calibration and free end cells are limited.
AlgaeBase images are illustrations, not a random sample of free end cells.
Turgor and wall thickness are not recorded with the photographs.
